name: BuiltSync
headline: Every worker, every shift, every site, in one place.
tagline: BuiltSync is the workforce operating system for project sites: a worker app and an admin console that connect people, attendance, certificates, leave and payroll.
intro: Built by Lenix for Singapore project sites, BuiltSync replaces paper timesheets and scattered spreadsheets. Workers check in from their phone with location and face verification, supervisors and admins see attendance as it happens, and the hours flow straight into payroll that workers can confirm or dispute. It is bilingual (Simplified Chinese and English) and is designed around work permits, NRIC/FIN, CPF and MOM-issued certificates.

pillars.title: Geofenced, face-verified attendance
pillars.text: Check-in and check-out use the phone's GPS against the site geofence plus face recognition. Late, early-leave, outside-geofence and missing punches are flagged for review automatically.

pillars.title: Payslips workers can trust
pillars.text: Payslips are generated from attendance and pay rules. Workers see gross pay, overtime, CPF and deductions, then confirm or dispute. Admins review, adjust and release payout.

pillars.title: Leave, from request to approval
pillars.text: Workers apply from the app against their balance. Supervisors approve on the go, and admins see everyone on a monthly leave calendar.

pillars.title: Certificates that never lapse unseen
pillars.text: Work permits and trade certificates are tracked with number, issuer and expiry. Workers and admins are reminded before anything expires.

pillars.title: Safety on every shift
pillars.text: Safety reminders on the home screen, an admin-set notice at check-in, site-entry quizzes and broadcasts keep safety in front of every worker.

pillars.title: One console for the whole workforce
pillars.text: Analytics, staff roster, projects and zones, roles and data scope, announcements and an audit log, in a bilingual admin console with Excel export.

flow.title: Check in
flow.text: The worker checks in on site. Location, time and face are verified.

flow.title: Monitor
flow.text: Admins see who is in, who is late and who is outside the geofence.

flow.title: Get paid
flow.text: Hours roll into payslips that workers confirm, or dispute, in the app.

demoNote: Screens show sample data and are rendered from the BuiltSync design set, translated to English for this preview.

app.title: Worker app
app.blurb: What every worker carries in their pocket. Tap the highlighted areas to move through the app.

modules.label: Start
modules.description: Sign in and land on a home screen built around documents, safety and updates.

modules.label: Attendance
modules.description: Geofenced, face-verified check-in and check-out, with exceptions flagged automatically.

modules.label: Pay
modules.description: Payslips workers can read, confirm or dispute.

modules.label: Leave
modules.description: Apply, track and approve leave from the phone.

modules.label: Certificates
modules.description: Permits and certificates with expiry reminders.

modules.label: Messages
modules.description: Notices and broadcasts in one place.

screens.title: Sign in
screens.caption: Workers sign in with their employee account or a mobile verification code. The language switch sits right on the login screen.

screens.title: Home
screens.caption: Key documents with expiry status, site safety reminders and the latest updates at a glance. Tap the tabs below to move around.

screens.title: Ready to check in
screens.caption: A live clock, the assigned project and shift, and a GPS check against the site geofence. Tap Check in to continue.

screens.title: Confirm check-in
screens.caption: Before checking in, the worker sees the admin-configured safety notice, their location and the time, and confirms they are wearing a helmet and are in their work zone.

screens.title: Face verification
screens.caption: Identity is verified by face recognition and the check-in is recorded with its location and time. Face data is used only for this check.

screens.title: Working
screens.caption: Once checked in, the card tracks the time worked this shift. Check out at the end of the day.

screens.title: Confirm check-out
screens.caption: Check-out shows the admin's end-of-shift notice, the location and the time. Hours are settled by the shift rules.

screens.title: Checked out
screens.caption: The day's hours and end time are recorded, and a punch can be updated if something needs correcting.

screens.title: Outside the geofence
screens.caption: If a worker is outside the site boundary, BuiltSync flags a location exception and shows the distance. The punch can still be made, and is marked for review.

screens.title: Attendance records
screens.caption: A monthly calendar with total hours, days present and exceptions. Green is normal, yellow is an exception.

screens.title: Pay records
screens.caption: Every month's payslip in one list, split into To confirm and Confirmed.

screens.title: Payslip details
screens.caption: Gross pay, overtime, incentive, CPF and other deductions, and net pay. Workers either confirm it is correct or raise a dispute.

screens.title: Leave
screens.caption: Leave balances by type, current status and recent requests, plus a shortcut for supervisors to approve their team's leave.

screens.title: Apply for leave
screens.caption: Pick the leave type and dates. The duration is calculated automatically against the available balance.

screens.title: Documents
screens.caption: Work permit, passport, safety and trade certificates with number, expiry date and status: valid, expiring soon or expired.

screens.title: Expiry reminder
screens.caption: Workers are reminded before a certificate lapses, with the issuer, expiry date and what to do next.

screens.title: Site-entry safety quiz
screens.caption: Quizzes and surveys support single choice, multiple choice, true/false and short-answer questions.

screens.title: Message centre
screens.caption: Attendance, pay, certificate and leave notices in one inbox, filterable by type.

screens.title: Broadcast
screens.caption: Announcements from HR, safety and project teams reach every worker's phone.

screens.title: Work hub
screens.caption: Switch project or zone, then jump to the attendance log, surveys, pay, leave and profile.

screens.title: Profile
screens.caption: Personal, employer and bank details, with face enrolment for attendance check-ins.

screens.title: Language
screens.caption: The app runs in Simplified Chinese or English, and workers can switch at any time.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.blurb: What project, HR and payroll teams use every day. Click the sidebar and tabs to move around.

modules.label: Analytics
modules.description: Hours, headcount and survey data in one view.

modules.label: Attendance
modules.description: Daily and monthly attendance, generated automatically.

screens.title: Admin sign-in
screens.caption: Administrators sign in to a bilingual console (中文 / English): one platform for projects, people, attendance, certificates and payroll.

screens.title: Analytics
screens.caption: Site hours, headcount, direct versus subcontracted manpower, hours by trade and survey completion. Filter by company, project and date, then export to Excel.

screens.title: Staff roster
screens.caption: Worker, supervisor and safety-officer profiles with company, trade, pay template, project assignment and status.

screens.title: Projects & zones
screens.caption: Maintain projects, zones, countries, contacts and project dates, with status from not started through to completed.

screens.title: Staff certificates
screens.caption: Track valid, expiring and expired certificates for every person, upload several per worker, and see who still needs one.

screens.title: Daily attendance summary
screens.caption: A day's scheduled, normal, exception and on-leave headcount. Late, early-leave and outside-geofence punches are flagged automatically.

screens.title: Daily detail
screens.caption: Check-in and check-out per person, with the result and notes. Attendance is generated by the system from schedules and punches.

screens.title: Monthly summary
screens.caption: Per-person totals for the month: normal, late, early leave, missing punch and leave.

screens.title: Payslips
screens.caption: Payslips are generated from attendance and pay rules. Admins review, adjust disputes, confirm and mark payout.

screens.title: Pay templates
screens.caption: Daily and monthly templates with basic hours, overtime rules across four day types, and linked staff.

screens.title: Leave approvals
screens.caption: A monthly calendar of everyone's leave. Click a date to see who is off, then approve or reject.

screens.title: Platform announcements
screens.caption: Publish announcements to all staff, a company or a project, in Chinese and English, by in-app notice or SMS.

screens.title: Surveys
screens.caption: Create safety checks and surveys, and see completion by audience and deadline.

screens.title: Roles & permissions
screens.caption: Role-based access to pages, actions and data scope, set per company or project.
